title: A "no" vote in Italy's referendum could be 'first blow' to Meloni's premiership
summary: Italy’s conservative premier, Giorgia Meloni, faces a pivotal political test in a two-day referendum on judicial reform that started on March 22. The vote has transformed into a broader judgement on her leadership at home and abroad. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta tells us more about the reform, the divide between the yes and no votes, and what the no's success co…
